verdict.rationale: Lindy documents one route to a custom or private integration: a developer can host an MCP server and point Lindy at it, and Lindy builds actions from the tools that server publishes (lindy-docs-14, lindy-docs-27). Lindy can also write its own integration against a tool's API using stored credentials (lindy-docs-15, lindy-docs-2, lindy-docs-22), but that work is done by the agent, not by a developer using a platform. The evidence shows no developer SDK, CLI or connector-building platform, and probes found no OpenAPI spec (lindy-probe-2). Missing for 10: documented developer SDK or CLI, a connector-building developer platform or API reference, an OpenAPI spec, guidance on authoring private connectors, independent corroboration.
